text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Currency (Full Colour Copying Machines) Regulations 1996 and shall come into operation on 1st May 1996.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Restriction on use of copying machine

text.en: 3. No person shall use a copying machine to reproduce any Singapore currency note.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Words, etc., to be printed behind colour copies

text.en:
4.—(1) A permit holder shall ensure that at the back of every colour copy produced by a copying machine —
(a)the word “COPY”; and
(b)the permit number relating to the copying machine,
are clearly printed in such manner as the Board may require.
(2) Paragraph (1) shall not apply if the copying machine is fitted with a counterfeit prevention system approved by the Board.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE
PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Only authorised persons to operate copying machine

text.en:
6.—(1) A permit holder shall submit to the Board a list of persons who are authorised to operate any copying machine in his possession.
(2) A permit holder shall ensure that any person whose name is not in the list of authorised persons will not be allowed to operate a copying machine.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

text.en: 7. Where a copying machine is not in use, a permit holder shall ensure that the copying machine is locked and kept in a place which is secured to prevent unauthorised access to the machine.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Board to be informed of loss or relocation of copying machine

text.en:
8.—(1) A permit holder shall inform the Board within 7 days if a copying machine in his possession or a main component thereof is stolen or missing.
(2) If a copying machine is removed to a place different from that previously reported to the Board, a permit holder shall give notice in writing of the removal to the Board within 7 days of the removal.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Board to be informed of scrapping of copying machine

text.en:
9. If a copying machine is to be disposed of by scrapping, a permit holder shall —
(a)render the copying machine incapable of any further use; and
(b)not later than 7 days after the scrapping, furnish to the Board a document certifying that the machine has been scrapped.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

heading.en: Board to be notified of exportation of copying machine

text.en: 10. If a copying machine is to be exported, a permit holder shall, not later than 7 days after the exportation, furnish to the Board a copy of the official export document certifying that the machine has been exported.

chapter.en: PART II USE OF COPYING MACHINE

text.en:
11. A permit holder shall at all reasonable times permit an authorised officer of the Board to —
(a)inspect and test a copying machine; and
(b)inspect and make copies of particulars entered in the register maintained under regulation 5,
and shall furnish any other relevant information the officer may require.

heading.en: Counterfeit prevention system to be fitted

text.en:
12.—(1) No person shall, on or after 1st May 1997, be granted permission under section 20A(1) of the Act to manufacture or import a copying machine unless that machine is fitted with a counterfeit prevention system approved by the Board.
(2) Paragraph (1) shall not apply to a copying machine that is imported for the purpose of re-export.

heading.en: Removal of or tampering with counterfeit prevention system prohibited

text.en: 13. No permit holder shall, or shall permit a person to, remove or by any means render less effective a counterfeit prevention system approved by the Board that has been fitted in a copying machine.

heading.en: Power of officer of Board to seal copying machine before seizure

text.en: 14. An authorised officer of the Board may seal a copying machine before seizing it under section 20A(5) of the Act.

15.—(1) The Board may, from time to time, require a permit holder to submit reports on such matters as the Board may require.
(2) Such reports must be submitted within 21 days of the requisition under paragraph (1) and must be in such form as the Board may require.
16. The Board may revoke the permission granted under section 20A(1) of the Act to any permit holder if he contravenes or fails to comply with any of these Regulations.
17. The Board may exempt any person from any of the provisions of these Regulations subject to such conditions as the Board thinks fit.
